basic_info.description: Welcome to this historic San Francisco landmark, The Malt House.  Here a bright, sophisticated & modern North facing 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom home awaits with views of the old silos, fountain and courtyard.  Many wonderful shops and restaurants are steps away in North Beach with live entertainment plus Trader Joe's, Fisherman's Wharf and Ghiradelli Square are walking distance.  This 1,284 square foot home, has high ceilings, open floor plan with living/dining and a kitchen with marble countertops,  stainless steel electric stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave. Each bedroom and bath are luxurious and spacious. Large closets in each bedroom and plush carpet in neutral tone.  This is an elevator building with a lobby decorated with canvas murals by French artist William Dupont & the courtyard has birch trees, magnolias, Japanese boxwood shrubs and silos from years gone by that celebrates the rich history of the Malt House. 1 parking spot & storage included. This one will not last, so please come by and visit your new home!
